status: Actual producer/public shape freeze r1; no consumer API edits without coordination. Host service behavior implemented, further Main tests ongoing. Not independent approval.

shape.message.send: Optional variant:string requires explicit model; omitted stays omitted. Current model membership/variant IDs validated before Native switch; model switch forwards variant only if present. Canonical admission digest includes request variant automatically.
shape.catalog.models.entries: WorkbenchModelEntry extends WorkbenchCatalogEntry + required variants:{status:available|unavailable,ids:string[]} + optional capabilities:{tools:boolean,input:string[],output:string[]}. Native overlays never exported. Bad/missing/duplicate/too many variants=>unavailable ids[]. Blank request means Native resolution, not reset. Model may remain selectable with unavailable variants if variant omitted.
shape.snapshot: Optional sessionSelection:{sessionId,agent?,model?:{providerId,id,variant?}}. Only successful current Native session refresh selected scope/trusted/connected/ready/nonblocked. Missing/failed refresh clears, no mutation ACK/cached report inference.
shape.messages: Optional runtime:{agent,model:{providerId,id,variant?}} on assistant only, from that Native message. Pure mapMessages projects metadata.custom.runtime as detached closed copy; never infer from session/request/catalog.
shape.helper: Public shared/runtime-options/index.ts and index.mjs export RUNTIME_OPTIONS_LIMITS,validRuntimeText,validRuntimeModel,validAssistantRuntime,validSessionSelection,validModelOptions,projectModelOptions,projectAssistantRuntime,projectSessionSelection. Boolean validators; projection absent malformed fields omitted. Native project functions map providerID -> public providerId.
shape.limits: Runtime text256 wellformed no control characters; variants64 exact opaque original IDs; capability lists32 strings64 unique. Unknown capabilities are read-only display, no attachment authority.
